Root cause: in src/csv.js, renderField wrapped fields containing `,`, `"`, `\n`, or `\r` in double quotes but never escaped internal double quotes by doubling them, producing malformed CSV.

Fix: inside the quoted-field branch, double every internal double quote with `text.replace(/"/g, '""')` before wrapping in quotes, matching the README spec ("Inside a quoted field, every double quote is escaped by doubling (`""`)").

Only src/csv.js was modified; exported names and signatures are unchanged, no dependencies added. Verified with `node --test --test-isolation=none`: all 12 tests pass (csv, export, format suites).
